natalie (Billing Ops): Heads-up: two enterprise customers reported April invoices where tax looks doubled and one customer received the same invoice_id twice. attaching redacted extract. :eyes:

natalie (Billing Ops): Extract:
```
invoice_id: 2025-04-INV-9001
customer: delta-enterprises
lines:
 - Usage (tokens): $1,200
 - Reserved credit: -$300
 - Tax: $180   <-- expected $108
 total: $1,080  <-- but ledger shows $1,008
```

mike (FinOps): Tax doubled? could be tax calculated before and after credit or tax rate applied twice. Was there a tax-related change in generator?

invoices-bot: WARNING: duplicate invoice_id detected for customer delta-enterprises: 2025-04-INV-9001 (batch invoice_run_2025_04_30).

reece (Payments): If ledger differs from PDF, gateway validation might fail. Also duplicate invoice_id can confuse reconciliation. Please pause auto-send.

alex (eng-billing): We deployed billing-engine v3.2.0 yesterday which included a refactor to tax_calculator and a change to apply credits as post-tax adjustments. Rolling back now would be safest but might leave partial runs.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: billing-engine v3.2.0 -> prod at 1801120000 by ci/pipeline. Rollback available to v3.1.8. Proceed? (yes/no)

natalie (Billing Ops): Don't rollback mid-batch. Proposed immediate steps: 1) pause invoice emission and email jobs 2) mark affected invoice_ids as investigating 3) run reconciliation to list mismatched totals 4) re-generate corrected PDFs after patch.

mike (FinOps): Quick recon SQL to find mismatches:
```
SELECT i.invoice_id, i.total as invoice_total, sum(il.amount) as line_total, ledger.charge_amount
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN ledger_charges ledger ON ledger.invoice_id=i.invoice_id
WHERE i.period='2025-04'
GROUP BY i.invoice_id, ledger.charge_amount
HAVING abs(coalesce(i.total,0) - coalesce(ledger.charge_amount,0)) > 1 OR abs(coalesce(sum(il.amount),0) - coalesce(ledger.charge_amount,0)) > 1;
```

natalie (Billing Ops): Ran it: 9 invoices with mismatched totals, 2 duplicates. For duplicates, both PDFs were sent but ledger only has one charge. For mismatch, ledger matches expected (pre-fixed) amounts, meaning renderer likely applied tax twice when building PDF.

tara (Support): One customer already opened a ticket upset about being "charged more" because PDF showed a bigger tax line. They were not actually charged more but this is high priority.

alex (eng-billing): Found suspicious log snippet: `INFO tax_calculator: applied_tax=108, adjustment_tax=72, final_tax=180 for invoice 2025-04-INV-9001 - credit_applied=-300 - flag use_new_tax_flow=true`. Looks like both legacy and new tax paths executed due to feature-flag gating bug.

reece (Payments): I've paused captures for the affected customers and disabled invoice-email-sender. Also flagged the duplicates in the notification queue.

natalie (Billing Ops): I'll create FIN-2025-201 and attach customer list. We should re-render PDFs after patch and send a short apology note. No refunds necessary but support wants clear copy.

mike (FinOps): Agreed. Alex, can you patch the feature-flag check to ensure only one tax path runs and provide a hotfix build? We'll schedule rollback only if hotfix isn't ready in 30m.

alex (eng-billing): Working on hotfix now. ETA 20-30m. I'll also add a unit test to ensure tax path exclusivity.

deploy-bot: Hotfix candidate build: billing-engine v3.2.1 created at 1801122400. Preflight: invoice_batch_2025_04_30 currently paused. Ready to promote? (yes/no)

natalie (Billing Ops): Promote hotfix, then re-render affected invoice_ids. I'll coordinate with Payments to resume emails after QA.

reece (Payments): Once re-rendered, we'll send corrected PDFs with subject "Corrected invoice - no change to charged amount" and include a short note.

mike (FinOps): Adding follow-up: add regression test covering duplicate invoice_id creation and add alert when renderer/pdf_count>1 for same invoice_id.

natalie (Billing Ops): FIN-2025-201 created and assigned to eng-billing. Will update thread after re-render and resend. :white_check_mark:
